Shot Bru

Measure the head · v1.0

How it works

  1. Stand over the jack. Phone flat, screen up, arms out at about chest height.
  2. Keep the jack inside the circle. The beeps speed up as the phone levels. It takes the photo itself when level and still.
  3. Tap the jack. Check the circle fits its edge, and adjust it if not. Then touch each bowl's edge nearest the jack.

Casual play only. When it says too close, get the measure out.

Settings

Phone height and bowl radius let it allow for seeing the bowls from above at an angle. A wrong height shifts all distances by about the same proportion, so it rarely changes the order.

–tilt

New game

Fours. Leave a name blank to use the position.

Optional: beside each player, the camera button takes one of their bowls from above, filling the frame, for colour. The ring button takes the bowl's face, filling the frame, for its sticker. Colour tags bowls where players' colours differ; stickers settle the rest.
